# SensationModulatingNetwork

**Domain**: iNEST
**First mentioned**: auto-extracted
**Last updated**: 2026-08-04

## Definition
A network architecture that modulates sensory input streams through topology-driven gating mechanisms, mimicking neural attention. Provides a neuromorphic substrate for TCC to implement adaptive filtering and selective processing directly in the network fabric.
